name: SustainMetrics Emission Factor API
description: 18,000+ GHG emission factors from UK DEFRA, US EPA, ADEME Base Carbone (France) and Ember (193-country grid intensity), normalized behind one endpoint and one auth scheme. The underlying data is public (Open Government Licence / US public domain / Licence Ouverte v2.0 — see /methodology) — what this API adds is a single schema across four sources, category/scope/search filtering, and uptime. Free tier: 50 requests/day, no credit card.
